description: Kubernetes management & triage coordinator. Diagnoses unhealthy workloads (crash-looping pods, deployments not ready, services unreachable) by delegating read-only kubectl evidence gathering to the k8s_investigator, delegates careful Helm-aware cluster changes to the k8s_editor, and delegates removal of ephemeral debug leftovers to the k8s_cleaner. Follows the k8s-triage playbook.
name: k8s_leader
